name: CaveGenerator
src_typeComment: Cellular-automata cave generation — a REFERENCE/SKELETON implementation (grid size, fill probability, iterations, and seed are the only knobs). Randomly seeds a grid with walls at fillProbability, then repeatedly smooths it with the classic "4-5 rule": a cell becomes a wall if 5+ of its 8 neighbors are walls, becomes floor if 3 or fewer are, and is left unchanged at exactly 4 — turning the grid's initial random noise into organic, cave-like open areas. Consume the output as:  bool[,] cave = CaveGenerator.Generate(60, 40, fillProbability: 0.45f, iterations: 4, seed: 42); if (cave[x, y]) /* true = wall — place rock/collider geometry here */
